none: PAS CAM-6BC8D6: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS, AD330-331
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS, AD330-331 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: - . Reverse shows Victory on prow. See RIC : VII p.214 no.523. Obverse legend reads: CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Obverse shows Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis facing left
